subject: storytime
title: Clifford words
about: Emily Elizabeth has a dog named Clifford who grew so big that he towers over her house, and his size turns baths, walks and games into funny adventures. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the short words first.

book.author: Norman Bridwell
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A girl and her enormous red dog show why the biggest pet on the street is also the best.

passage.text:
Clifford Emily dog red
big house car bone
dig bath bark run
play hide fetch tricks
loves very

cards.note: capital C, it is his name; c-l blend; ff is one f; two parts: Clif + ford
capital E, it is her name; three parts: Em-i-ly; y at the end says ee
ou says ow, like in out; se at the end just says s: hows
magic e makes o say its name
ar says ar, like in car
p-l blend; ay says long a
magic e makes i say its name
tch is one sound, like ch
t-r blend; ck is one sound; the s says s
o says u; ve says v; the s says z: luvz
er says air here, like in berry; y at the end says ee: vair-ee
